narrative.northStar: Sunlit Coastal Consumer Utility (Urban Company × Apple Health × Swiggy)
narrative.overview: Warm, tactile consumer mobile app for Dakshina Kannada plastic waste reporting and recycling.
keyCharacteristics: Cool sunlit mist canvas (#f4f7f5) with soft shadow-elevated white cards (no boxy wireframe borders).
Vibrant Coastal Emerald (#0d7a57) hero cards paired with Sunlit Marigold (#f59e0b) rewards accents.
Plus Jakarta Sans + Noto Sans Kannada across all UI and tabular numbers (zero monospace costume).
Circular tactile map pins, dotless tinted status tags, and full-card interactive pickup rows.

rules.name: No Wireframe Slop
rules.body: Elevate cards with soft ambient shadows rather than heavy 1px borders around every block.

rules.name: No Fake Status Dots
rules.body: Use clean semantic tint labels or meaningful icons (like StarIcon for points) instead of decorative dots inside pills.

dos: Use Plus Jakarta Sans + Noto Sans Kannada with tabular-nums for all numbers.
Use circular tactile map pins and full-card tappable pickup cards.
donts: Don't use beige backgrounds, monospace stamps, fake dots inside pills, or repetitive Track > wireframe buttons.
